target.title: fix(zalo): make poll error backoff abort-aware
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Zalo polling error backoff used a bare `setTimeout(5000)` that ignored `abortSignal` / stop. After a non-timeout poll error, Gateway stop or account switch could leave the backoff sleep running for the full 5s (orphan timer / delayed poll continuation). Sibling Signal `sse-reconnect` and Slack reconnect already use `sleepWithAbort`.

Open [#104017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104017) adds Bot API request timeouts; it does not fix poll error backoff sleep.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the bare sleep with abort-aware backoff matching Signal/Slack:

```ts
try {
  await sleepWithAbort(5000, abortSignal);
} catch {
  return;
}
```

No new config/env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** After a poll transport error, abort/stop still waited out (or left running) a 5s `setTimeout` before the polling loop fully wound down.

**After:** Abort during error backoff ends the sleep immediately and returns from the poll loop.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/zalo/src/monitor.ts`
- Production caller: `startPollingLoop` inside `monitorZaloProvider` (polling mode)
- Sibling: `extensions/signal/src/sse-reconnect.ts` (`sleepWithAbort`)
- Regression: `extensions/zalo/src/monitor.lifecycle.test.ts`

### Caller-path Vitest

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalo/src/monitor.lifecycle.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ ... > stays alive in polling mode until abort
 ✓ ... > ends poll error backoff immediately when abort fires 54ms
 ✓ ... > deletes an existing webhook before polling
 ✓ ... > continues polling when webhook inspection returns 404
 ✓ ... > waits for webhook deletion before finishing webhook shutdown
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 13.07s
```

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior or issue addressed:**
Zalo poll error backoff ignored abort, so stop/account switch could leave a full 5s sleep running.

**Canonical reachability path:**
`monitorZaloProvider` (polling) → `startPollingLoop` → poll error → `sleepWithAbort(5000, abortSignal)`

**Real environment tested:**
Local Vitest with mocked `getUpdates` rejecting, then abort during the backoff window.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalo/src/monitor.lifecycle.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**Evidence after fix:**
```text
 ✓ ... > ends poll error backoff immediately when abort fires 54ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 13.07s
```

**Observed result after fix:**
Abort during the 5s error backoff settles the monitor in well under 1s (observed ~54ms for the new case) instead of waiting out 5000ms.

**What was not tested:**
Live Zalo Bot API credentials / production poll traffic.

**Fix classification:**
bug fix — make poll error backoff abort-aware
